# openmetadata_tag Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata tag by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_tag" "confidential" {
  fully_qualified_name = "Sensitivity.Confidential"
}

output "confidential_tag_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_tag.confidential.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Tag fully qualified name, in the form classification.name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Tag UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `classification` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent classification.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether an asset may carry only one tag from the classification.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
